August 6, 2026

Trump says U.S. held all-day talks with Iran as Tehran denies negotiations

tags: politics, war
sources: @oafnation_actual

President Trump said negotiations involving Iran were "moving along very nicely" and that more could be known within 48 hours, describing all-day talks with Tehran. Qatar reported progress by mediators, but Iranian officials denied that direct talks were already underway. Trump also linked the diplomatic movement to recent record highs in the stock market.

Trump post on munitions stocks follows Camp David clash with Hegseth over shortage

tags: defence, politics
sources: @aaronparnas, @oafnation_actual

In a late-night post, Trump said the United States has massive amounts of munitions, that large quantities are being manufactured, and that "leakers of these treasonous statements" would be hunted down and face long-term jail sentences. The post responded to reporting that U.S. weapons stocks have been drawn down by the war in Iran. According to two people who spoke to the Washington Post, Trump pressed Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth at a Camp David meeting last Friday over reports that Hegseth had left him with the impression the shortage was already resolved, and Hegseth blamed his deputy Stephen Feinberg for the shortfall and for failing to keep Trump informed.

Iran warns Gulf states it will strike energy infrastructure if U.S. attacks again

tags: war, energy
sources: @oafnation_actual

Five sources told Reuters that Iran has threatened Gulf energy sites and infrastructure in the event of new U.S. strikes on Iranian territory. Tehran also urged Gulf allies to restrain Trump from ordering further attacks.

New Mexico sues Justice Department over access to Epstein records

tags: legal, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

The New Mexico Department of Justice filed a lawsuit against the Trump Justice Department, accusing it of stonewalling access to documents tied to the state's criminal investigation into Jeffrey Epstein's conduct at the Zorro Ranch. The state attorney general says the investigation is the only active criminal probe into Epstein's crimes and that federal officials have withheld records despite repeated promises to cooperate with state and local law enforcement. A similar suit previously secured the release of unredacted documents in the Epstein probe.

FCC repeals cap limiting broadcast station ownership reach

tags: media, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

The Federal Communications Commission scrapped a 22-year-old rule barring any single broadcast company from owning stations reaching more than 39% of U.S. households. Ownership reach will now be assessed case by case, clearing the way for corporate consolidation of local broadcast stations to begin almost immediately.

Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt of Congress

tags: politics, health
sources: @aaronparnas

Republicans on a Senate committee voted 8-5 to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after Democrats failed in an attempt to table the vote. Rand Paul and other Republicans on the committee said Fauci had refused to answer their questions. The committee could theoretically send a criminal referral to the Justice Department, though it is unclear whether prosecutors would act on it.

ICE officer describes Palantir targeting app and loyalty monitoring inside the agency

tags: surveillance, immigration
sources: @oafnation_actual

In an anonymous interview, an ICE enforcement officer said the agency uses ELITE, a Palantir-built targeting system developed with DHS that comes preinstalled on agency phones, with a mobile version for license plate checks and a desktop version for in-depth analysis of potential targets. The officer said the mobile app was tested during Operation Metro Surge and warned that over-reliance on AI can produce bad arrests and improper checks. The officer also criticised a mandatory White House app on work phones as propaganda, described growing surveillance of federal employees' loyalty to the president, and compared recent government and Pentagon firings to purges.

Deportation push has cost taxpayers an average of $2,358 each

tags: immigration, economy
sources: @aaronparnas

According to the Economic Policy Institute, American taxpayers have paid an average of $2,358 each to fund the administration's mass deportation effort, with residents of higher-tax jurisdictions such as Washington, D.C. paying roughly $3,900. The same sum could instead have covered SNAP benefits for hundreds of thousands of people, public housing assistance for tens of thousands, or Medicaid for 30,000. No tariff refunds or stimulus payments are expected.

Trump files emergency motion to block BBC from obtaining financial records

tags: legal, media
sources: @aaronparnas

Trump filed an emergency motion asking a court to stay a prior order requiring him to turn over financial records linked to the January 6th insurrection to the BBC. The order arose from discovery in Trump's own $10 billion lawsuit against the broadcaster, with the first production deadline set for the following day. Motions asking a judge to reconsider or stay an existing order are difficult to win.

Marine One came within 0.8 miles of passenger jet after air traffic control lapse

tags: government
sources: @aaronparnas

New York Times reporting says the military helicopter carrying Trump came within 0.8 miles laterally and 700 feet vertically of an Envoy Air flight, a breach of the FAA's safe separation standard of 1.5 miles laterally or 500 feet vertically. The Marine One crew attempted to warn controllers in the National Airport tower before takeoff but the communications were not heard, putting the helicopter in the jet's path. The White House said the president was at no point in harm's way and that it retains full confidence in the Marine One staff.

Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate primary despite heavy AIPAC spending

tags: politics, elections
sources: @hunteralexanderhowell

Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan after more than $40 million in AIPAC-linked spending failed to defeat him. Supporters framed the result, alongside Thomas Massie's earlier primary win, as a rejection of lobbying money in congressional races. El-Sayed now faces a general election contest in November.

U.S. presses ahead with talks on Patriot missile production in Ukraine

tags: defence, war
sources: @oafnation_actual

Talks on producing Patriot missiles in Ukraine are continuing despite Trump casting doubt on the plan. New interceptors from any such arrangement remain at least a year away.

Car bombing near Yekaterinburg wounds Russian drone factory chief and kills his driver

tags: war
sources: @oafnation_actual

Russian media reported that a car bombing near Yekaterinburg seriously wounded the head of a Russian drone manufacturer and killed his driver. The vehicle was destroyed in the blast.

Zaporizhzhia residents describe intensified Russian drone and glide-bomb attacks

tags: war
sources: @oafnation_actual

Residents of Zaporizhzhia say intensified Russian drone and glide-bomb attacks are spreading fear and disrupting daily life, with some describing the strikes as a "safari." Russia denies targeting civilians.

Two Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon as Rome talks continue

tags: war
sources: @oafnation_actual

Two Israeli soldiers were killed as violence flared in Lebanon, and Israel launched strikes in the south of the country. The escalation came while talks in Rome were still underway.

Taiwan begins 10-day military drills testing wartime command

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

Taiwan began major military exercises designed to test commanders against unexpected wartime scenarios and flexible command arrangements. The drills run for 10 days and involve more than 20,000 reservists.

Rubio and Miliband discuss Ukraine and expanded European security role

tags: politics, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

U.S. and U.K. officials discussed Ukraine and a greater European role in regional security. Ukraine was on the agenda for the talks between Rubio and Miliband.

Study finds brain aneurysms three times more common among high-blast special operations personnel

tags: health, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

A study of U.S. special operations personnel found brain aneurysms were about three times more common in the group with higher exposure to repeated blasts. The finding links occupational blast exposure to vascular injury in the brain.

Trump's tech industry ties draw bipartisan criticism over AI hacking risks

tags: tech, politics
sources: @oafnation_actual

Critics from both parties say Trump's ties to the technology industry have limited his administration's response to security risks posed by AI-enabled hacking. The criticism centres on the adequacy of the federal response to those threats.

Save Our Bacon Act stripped from Senate farm bill as Republicans push to restore it

tags: politics, legal
sources: @aaronparnas

The Senate Agriculture Committee will consider its version of the farm bill, from which Republican Senator John Boozman removed the Save Our Bacon Act. Senator Joni Ernst is pushing behind the scenes to reinstate the provision, and agricultural industry groups are lobbying Democratic senators including Amy Klobuchar to support its return. The measure, introduced last year by Representative Ashley Hinson, would bar states from regulating animal welfare and could roll back existing state laws.

Former OpenAI forecaster warns of catastrophic AI risk and autonomous agent behaviour

tags: tech
sources: @ericmoutsos

A former OpenAI researcher who worked on forecasting said the industry's open secret is the possibility of creating a new species that ends up ruling the world, putting roughly a 70% chance on outcomes as severe as human extinction. He said he resigned and forfeited around $2 million by refusing to sign a non-disparagement clause, and that he has shortened his timelines to 2027 and 2028 because rival CEOs are racing each other for control of the most powerful systems. An interviewee also described an AI agent that autonomously purchased and shipped a robot dog and requested permission to program it, and claimed agents have traded large sums among themselves.

Crowd at Trump event boos mention of deceased police officer's name

tags: politics
sources: @aaronparnas

At a Trump event in Nevada, the state's governor mentioned Officer Abdel Nabi, a police officer who recently died. Members of the crowd booed on hearing the name, prompting the governor to interject that the officer had passed away and that no one should be booing him.

Veteran lawmaker rebukes Markey over Iraq war vote in war crimes exchange

tags: politics, war
sources: @oafnation_actual

Responding to Senator Ed Markey, a veteran lawmaker said Markey had voted to send them to the Iraq war and should not lecture them on the definition of a war crime. They said they have repeatedly called out Netanyahu's conduct in Gaza and elsewhere, as well as war crimes by Russia and the United States, naming Pete Hegseth. They also noted Markey had been unable to admit his Iraq war vote was a mistake and had confused Iran with Vietnam while discussing a $1 trillion war budget.
